context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing Page Generator feature is fully functional. Backend endpoints at /api/landing-pages/*. Public routes (/api/landing-pages/public/{slug} and /api/landing-pages/public/{slug}/contact) don't require auth. Theme auto-selection: 'luxury' for >= $1M, 'modern' for < $1M. Preview URL format: https://hiddenhavenrealty.com/[slug]. Contact form submissions create leads with source='landing_page'. iDrive upload for videos/images requires credentials to be configured.
